item.title: Supporting growth of female coaches
item.description: World Sailing is now accepting applications for the Women in Sport High Performance Pathway (WISH) Program, a unique initiative designed to increase female representation in elite sport coaching at Olympic, World Championship, and other major event level. item.title: Caribbean 600: Different but the same
item.description: Seventeen editions into its history, the 2026 RORC Caribbean 600 delivered again for 56 teams. The eleven islands of the course have not changed, yet each year the subtle changes to the trade winds write a different script, as does the profound experience of the international alumni of sailors that take part. item.title: USA win at SailGP Sydney
item.description: USA won the third event of the 2026 SailGP season held February 28-March 1 in Sydney, Australia. After qualifying third into the Final, the U.S. SailGP Team sailed to victory ahead of Great Britain in second and Spain in third. It marks the first victory since an ownership change installed a new crew December 2023. item.title: Demonstrating a fundamental truth
item.description: Istvan Kopar competed in the inaugural edition of the Golden Globe Race — a race that rekindled the spirit of the original 1968 solo non-stop circumnavigation challenge. That 2018-19 journey culminated in him becoming the only American — across both editions to date — to complete the course. item.title: Don’t let life get in the way
item.description: Life can get in the way of sailing, but Richard Joules found a way back in: I was introduced to sailing in the Bahamas as a five-year-old - 56 years ago. That start in my sailing journey has taken me to many highs, from the bow of the boat to the cockpit, starlit nights on deck to watching spectacular sun rises and sets.
